verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents classifying transactions by category, cost center and supplier (merchant), and linking receipts and invoices to transactions. It also supports updating and reconciling transactions, and markets that each payment can appear already categorized by area, owner and expense type, with an end to expense spreadsheets. Together these cover the core of coding spend as it happens for a review-style close. Missing for 10: no explicit memo/notes field, no evidence of receipt capture at the moment of purchase (e.g., mobile prompts or missing-receipt chasing), detail on how auto-categorization rules work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
